question: In respect of Arunachal Pradesh, the Governor has special responsibility under ________ of the Constitution of India with respect to law and order and in discharge of his functions in relation thereto.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 371 H.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 371H **contains special provisions w. r. t. the Arunachal Pradesh, granting the Governor certain responsibilities and powers, **particularly relating to law and order**.
